description: Move a pending ANS agent one validation round toward ACTIVE: publishes the DNS records the registry wants now and asks it to check them. Call repeatedly until `agentStatus` is ACTIVE (usually 2-4 calls). On ANS_DNS_PENDING, wait about 30 seconds and call again; `missingRecords` lists what it is waiting for (if those are at the user's own DNS host, tell them to add them). Safe to repeat.

agent_id.description: The agentId from register_ans_agent or list_ans_agents.
